sources.entry: Claude Code Harness by Chachamaru - A Claude Code development harness that enables reliable high-quality development through an autonomous Plan -> Work -> Review cycle. Well documented and includes an Output Style.

summary.one_liner: A development harness for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Grok and others) that runs a Plan, Work, Review cycle driven by spec.md and Plans.md files.
summary.what_it_does: Harness adds slash-command or skill workflows to a coding assistant: /harness-plan drafts spec.md and Plans.md with tasks, completion criteria, and unknowns for the user to approve; /harness-work runs approved tasks with checks; /harness-review asks a separate reviewer to examine the change; /harness-sync compares the recorded plan with the project state; /harness-release prepares a release plan. Progress is shown via /harness-progress, and interrupted runs can be resumed with /harness-work --resume latest. Execution hooks run a bundled Go-native guardrail engine that checks protected files, direct pushes to main, forced pushes, and other risky operations. Larger jobs can be split with /breezing, and /harness-loop repeats work up to a default of eight cycles.
use_cases: Planning a small feature change with reviewable acceptance criteria
Running approved multi-task work with checks inside an AI coding assistant
Getting a separate review of AI-written code before publishing
Tracking task status and pending decisions for an AI-driven project
Resuming an interrupted AI coding session
Preparing a versioned release with an approved publication plan
how_to_run: Install and sign in to a supported coding assistant (e.g., Claude Code v2.1+)
In Claude Code, run: /plugin marketplace add Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness
Run: /harness-plan <your small change>, then /harness-work all, then /harness-review
For other tools, clone the repo and run the matching scripts/setup-<tool>.sh script (e.g., setup-codex.sh --user, setup-cursor.sh, setup-grok.sh)
stack: Go (guardrail engine; Go 1.26.0+ to build from source)
notable: Plan, Work, Review workflow with spec.md and Plans.md as shared job sheet and checklist
Separate reviewer role for checking implementation apart from its author
Go-native guardrail engine that applies execution-hook permission rules without requiring Node.js
Bilingual docs with Japanese language option (CLAUDE_CODE_HARNESS_LANG=ja)
caveats: Support tiers vary by tool: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and Grok are marked supported; OpenCode is internal-compatible; Codex app, Hermes Agent, and GitHub Copilot CLI are candidate; Antigravity CLI is unsupported
Cursor has no traditional filesystem isolation; restrictions are applied by Harness, and native Codex child agents can inherit parent permissions
Guardrails do not guarantee every command is contained; the Codex --user setup replaces existing worker.toml and reviewer.toml files
